orders.text:
WPSS No. 3322 of 2017 
With

Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for the 
petitioners. 
Mr. T.S. Bist, Deputy Advocate 
General for the State of Uttarakhand / 
respondent Nos. 1 and 2. 
Mr. Sanjay Kumar Joshi, Advocate on 
behalf of Mr. Kartikey Hari Gupta, Advocate 
for respondent No. 3. 
Delay in filing counter affidavit by 
respondent Nos. 1 and 2 has been sufficiently 
explained. Delay Condonation Application 
(CLMA No. 3322 of 2017) is allowed. Delay 
in filing counter affidavit is condoned. 
Counter affidavit filed by respondent Nos. 1 
and 2 is taken on record. 
Learned counsel for the petitioners 
prays for and is granted two weeks’ time to 
file rejoinder affidavit to the counter affidavit 
filed by respondent Nos. 1 and 2. 
List thereafter. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 11.06.2018
